what: While the mouse (finger) is held down on the panel, one logo piece per frame (up to 35 at once) pops up from the cursor — size one of 15·20·25·35·45px, upward 0~25 · sideways 0~10px/frame (half left, half right), initial angle 0~360° · rotation ±0~35°/frame. The upward speed drops by 1 per frame (never exceeding its own size) so it falls in a parabola while spinning, and vanishes once below the screen. Dragging while held moves the spray point with the cursor — the rainbow spray of the Cool Mode in the wallet-connect tool intro
ease: None — constant acceleration per frame (gravity 1px/frame², at 60fps)

options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Image to stamp as pieces (one child, may be hidden) — if none, an accent-color rounded square (25% corner radius)
options.max: Number of pieces floating at once, default 35
options.up · side · spin · fall: Max speed upward (default 25) · sideways (10), max rotation (35°), gravity (1) — all per frame

from.where: index.html .rk-copy (holding the install-command copy button spews out logo pieces — original RainbowKit coolMode. The original also turns it on page-wide when a wallet is connected)

note: Like the original, it clears only once it falls below the larger of the screen height and the document height (it keeps running meanwhile, even off-screen). To stop even when released outside the panel, it also listens to the window’s mouseup and blur. Touch is received as passive so it doesn’t block scrolling
